content_of_post_to_answer: Why is relaxation important for overall wellness?
answer: Relaxation is often misunderstood as the opposite of productivity, when it is actually part of the process that makes sustained effort possible. The mind and body need periods of recovery to process stress, restore attention, and regulate emotions. A useful distinction is that distraction numbs exhaustion, while true relaxation restores capacity. Rest is not time taken away from living well; it is what allows us to return to life with more clarity.
